release_notes: Fixes a blank page in the domain form: typing into the custom SSL certificate or key path crashed the page with "AlertTriangle is not defined" — the icon had been used since custom SSL support landed but was never imported, so the screen went white the moment either path was filled (issue #19). The top bar is now responsive by measurement: full labels, icons-only with the active label and hover tooltips, or the side drawer — chosen from the actual row widths per language, permissions and username instead of the fixed 1280px breakpoint that pushed Domains, the gear menu, the theme toggle and the profile off-screen on 1280–1700px windows. The Landings tab gets its own icon so it no longer duplicates Domains.
